map.根据肿瘤大小和分泌功能对垂体瘤进行分型，给出管理建议与随访策略: Classify pituitary tumours by size and secretory function, with management advice and follow-up strategy

map.按最大径分型：不超过 10 mm 为微腺瘤、10 至 40 mm 为大腺瘤、超过: By maximum diameter: 10mm or less is a microadenoma, 10 to 40mm a macroadenoma and over 40mm a giant adenoma. By secretory function: prolactinoma (raised PRL, first-line dopamine agonists), growth hormone tumour (raised GH and IGF-1), ACTH tumour (raised cortisol, Cushing disease), TSH tumour and non-functioning tumour. Follow-up is arranged by type: MRI and hormones every 1 to 2 years for a non-functioning microadenoma, and PRL rechecked 3 months after a prolactinoma starts medication.
map.≥10mm，可向鞍上/鞍旁扩展: 10mm or more, may extend suprasellar or parasellar
map.无激素分泌，可有压迫症状: No hormone secretion, may cause pressure symptoms
map.Knosp 3-4级，累及海绵窦: Knosp grade 3-4, involving the cavernous sinus
map.未达海绵窦内侧静脉丛: Does not reach the medial venous plexus
map.达内侧+外侧静脉丛之间: Reaches between the medial and lateral venous plexus
map.达外侧静脉丛（侵入海绵窦）: Reaches the lateral venous plexus (invades the cavernous sinus)
map.完全包绕颈内动脉（完全侵入）: Fully encases the internal carotid artery (complete invasion)
map.泌乳素瘤首选多巴胺激动剂(溴隐亭/卡麦角林)药物治疗。其他功能性大腺瘤和无功能大: Prolactinomas are treated first with a dopamine agonist (bromocriptine or cabergoline). Other functioning macroadenomas and non-functioning macroadenomas with pressure symptoms go for transsphenoidal surgery first. Symptom-free microadenomas can be followed with periodic MRI. Pituitary function must be assessed after surgery and followed long term.

map.PRL>100 ng/mL 伴微腺瘤→多为泌乳素瘤（多巴胺激动剂一线）；GH 与: PRL over 100 ng/mL with a microadenoma is most often a prolactinoma (dopamine agonist first-line); raised GH and IGF-1 with a sellar mass indicates acromegaly (GH tumour); a non-functioning macroadenoma is followed mainly on pressure symptoms and visual field loss.
map.大腺瘤与小腺瘤怎么分？: How are macroadenomas and microadenomas separated?
map.以最大径 10 mm 为界；大腺瘤更易压迫视交叉与海绵窦，需评估视野与神经压迫。: A maximum diameter of 10mm is the boundary; macroadenomas are more likely to compress the optic chiasm and cavernous sinus, so visual fields and nerve compression must be assessed.
map.PRL 升高一定是瘤吗？: Does a raised PRL always mean a tumour?
map.不一定。药物（如抗精神病药）、妊娠、原发性甲减（TRH 刺激）、钩援现象（采血困: Not always. Drugs (such as antipsychotics), pregnancy, primary hypothyroidism (TRH stimulation) and the hook effect (difficult sampling causing haemolysis) can all cause a false rise, so imaging is needed too.
map.垂体瘤按大小(微/大/巨大腺瘤)和分泌功能分类，结合Knosp分级评估侵袭性，指: Pituitary tumours are classified by size (micro/macro/giant adenoma) and secretory function, with Knosp grading adding an invasion assessment, guiding surgical and drug treatment decisions.
